name: Extract network statistics and connectivity matrices from network datatype
summary: Converts a network datatype (JSON graph with node measurements) into CSV tables of connectivity matrices and global and local network statistics with pybrainlife, a format conversion utility.
description: Loads the compressed JSON graph with jgf/igraph and uses pybrainlife to extract its connectivity matrices and global and local (per-node) measures, writing conmats.csv, global_measures.csv and local_measures.csv tagged with the subject and session. Use it to prepare network outputs for group analysis; for networks without measurements use the no-measures variant.

inputs.description: Network datatype (compressed JSON graph) that includes network measurements.

outputs.description: CSV tables: conmats.csv (connectivity matrices), global_measures.csv and local_measures.csv.
